description.value: Harrison Hammond House is a 25-acre rural farmstay at the confluence of the Harrison and Fraser rivers near Harrison Mills, about 1.5 hours east of Vancouver. The property offers mountain views, a hot tub, wood-burning fireplace, and organic gardens, alongside an unusual secondary use as a musician's rehearsal studio. Touring cyclists are well-placed to access the Harrison Hot Springs corridor, Kilby Museum, and river kayaking routes from this secluded base.

address.value: 1926 School Road, Harrison Mills, Kent District, BC V0M 1L0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and provides the primary evidence. No bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, or most amenity details are mentioned anywhere on the site. The location page lists 'Sasquatch pub (3 minutes)' as a nearby attraction, confirming nearby evening food. A name mismatch exists: OSM records 'Harrison Hammond House B&B' but the website consistently uses 'Harrison Hammond House Farmstay and Rehearsal Studio'; the community field in OSM says Chilliwack but the property address and website both place it in Harrison Mills, Kent District.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Harrison Hammond House B&B' but the website consistently uses 'Harrison Hammond House Farmstay and Rehearsal Studio'.
Community mismatch: OSM community field says 'Chilliwack' but the property is located in Harrison Mills, Kent District — a different municipality.
Website appears significantly outdated: copyright footers range from 2011 to 2021, several gallery/studio pages still require Adobe Flash Player, suggesting content has not been maintained in years.
No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, e-bike charging, wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site; all required and most optional criteria are unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate rural farmstay in a scenic cycling corridor, but the website makes no mention of any bike-specific services; direct outreach is needed to confirm secure storage and staff readiness before listing in a cycling-focused directory.
